answer: Sequential work receipts. Each identity must submit a valid solution to a unique, freshly generated puzzle whose answer depends on the prior block's hash—an ember that only burns once. Duplicate answers fail verification, so copying another agent's output is useless. A new identity pays the full compute cost to reach each vertex in the chain alone. The attacker's per-identity delta is the wasted solving work for every attempt, since cloned answers are rejected outright.
